name: south-korea-travel-companion
description: Offline-first South Korea travel companion (Daegu-focused): map, transit, residency pin, SOS, currency, phrasebook.

scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs win32 x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs darwin arm64
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs linux x64
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
